title: Experience when calling the surgery
content:
Managed to get through to reception without waiting too long. Spoke to a very pleasant supportive receptionist who explained the process.
A Dr rang back within 10mins and was able to issue a prescription.
I know lots of people have not had such a positive experience but I was impressed with the care and attention that received today and felt it worthy of a review.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
